hispalGym.title: Autonomous access and management for gyms, with nobody at reception
hispalGym.description: Open your gym whenever you want. Hispal GYM opens and controls the door with the member's phone and manages everything else: payments, shop, classes, routines, staff and home automation. Each centre chooses how its members get in: QR only, face only, or QR and face, with a people-counting sensor and an alarm if more than one person goes through a single access.
points: Sign-up and payment by card or Bizum from the phone, any time
QR and face recognition access, integrated with Kimaldi, plus a counting sensor: one ID, one person
Shop with invoices, classes and activities, routines and exercises, and staff control with full traceability
Home automation: lights and gates from the dashboard, with music and alarms over the venue speakers
Adapted to your gym: custom features and integrations with your current system
